purpose: Request comparable, traceable technical responses for the rotating-carrier mechanism without allowing suppliers to infer final product loads from incomplete decorative mass assumptions.
commonInformationToAllSuppliers: 240 suspended elements rotate as one field
rotating carrier coordination envelope approximately 2260 x 1330 mm with 24 mm coordination thickness parameter
no powered rotating loads and no slip ring under current architecture
actual rotating mass, center of gravity, dynamic amplification, bearing loads, drive torque and brake torque remain controlled unknowns pending physical evidence

supplierPackages.scope: primary bearing / slewing or crossed-roller architecture
informationToSupplier: speed envelope
available canopy envelope
vertical-axis suspended rotating carrier
combined load calculation will be supplied before final selection
very low running noise and torque are product requirements
requiredSupplierResponse: recommended bearing family and exact candidate variant only if the supplier has enough data to recommend one
combined-load calculation method or load diagram
starting/running torque method and available values for proposed variant
mounting flatness, rigidity, datum and fastener requirements
prohibitedAssumptions: do not assume suspended glass/acrylic mass
do not treat catalog maximum load as VX4800 design load
do not assume mounting structure is perfectly rigid
do not assume a bearing with internal seals provides secondary retention

supplierPackages.scope: fixed motor/reducer and positive carrier drive
informationToSupplier: carrier output speed 0.08 to 0.65 rpm
jerk-limited motion is preferred study
normal direction reversal is not currently approved
drive must not be primary structural support
final torque and inertia will follow measured mass/dynamic tests
requiredSupplierResponse: motor/reducer family suitable for continuous very-low-speed motion
speed regulation method and minimum stable speed
efficiency and thermal data across proposed operating range
torque-speed curves once final load inputs are issued
prohibitedAssumptions: do not size final torque before approved load cases
do not use gearbox self-locking as the service lock
do not assume motor brake alone contains transmission failure

supplierPackages.scope: synchronous belt / toothed carrier ring transmission
informationToSupplier: positive non-slip transmission preferred over friction drive
carrier speed envelope
large carrier ring packaging study
bearing/support reactions from belt tension must be controlled
requiredSupplierResponse: recommended belt/tooth family for large-diameter slow positioning duty
predicted static tension and shaft/separation forces after torque case is provided
prohibitedAssumptions: do not set belt tension from rule of thumb
do not ignore pretension in bearing/support reactions
do not assume low rpm eliminates tooth-jump or alignment risks

informationToSupplier: fixed-side brake preferred
passive rotating annular brake ring/disc
spring-applied/electrically released or equivalent power-off architecture under study
service lock remains separate
final holding/stopping torque and energy remain unknown
requiredSupplierResponse: candidate caliper/brake family for direct disc/ring application
required disc/ring thickness and friction material compatibility
clamping/tangential force data and method to convert to holding torque at selected radius
static holding versus dynamic-stop capability and any limitations of each duty
maximum energy and thermal duty method
prohibitedAssumptions: do not select final brake size before approved torque/energy cases
do not assume static holding rating equals emergency-stop capability
do not treat brake as mechanical service lock
do not require rotating electrical power

supplierPackages.scope: fixed-side carrier position/speed feedback with passive rotating target
informationToSupplier: powered electronics should remain fixed
carrier speed can be as low as 0.08 rpm
service index/reference may be required
runout and air-gap tolerance must be designed rather than assumed
requiredSupplierResponse: fixed readhead plus passive ring/scale/target options
resolution and update behavior at very low speed
independent second-channel options if risk assessment requires overspeed plausibility
prohibitedAssumptions: do not introduce powered rotating encoder electronics without architecture change
do not claim functional-safety capability unless the exact variant and complete safety architecture support it
do not assume one feedback channel is sufficient before risk assessment

supplierPackages.scope: prototype structural hub/support ring, service lock and secondary-retention fabrication
informationToSupplier: controlled outer canopy/carrier envelopes
primary and secondary structural paths are separate
precision bearing support requirements will follow selected bearing
service lock and retention require proof-test access
requiredSupplierResponse: fabrication/machining capability for large flat bearing support rings
achievable post-weld machining flatness and inspection method
NDT options for critical structural features
prohibitedAssumptions: do not weld after final bearing-face machining without controlled distortion review
do not use decorative skin as structure
do not combine primary bearing bolts and secondary-retention attachments by convenience without approved common-cause review

commonSubmittals: exact manufacturer and candidate family/variant identification
2D mating drawing and 3D CAD where available
all numeric ratings tied to the exact proposed variant and operating condition
application-engineering calculation or selection record where supplied
commercial lead time separated from technical approval
commercialAndTechnicalSeparation: A low price, short lead time or supplier recommendation cannot close an engineering promotion gate without the required calculation and physical evidence.
releaseRule: RFQ responses may populate the qualification shortlist, but no bearing, drive, belt/gear, brake or feedback component becomes selected until exact measured inputs and approved load/fault cases are available and the repository promotion gates are deliberately updated.
